title: When the Wreck Turns
premise: Ulyana Amberdale, a disgraced mountain guide hiding from a past betrayal, is given a hand-drawn map by a dying prospector named Corliss in exchange for a promise: deliver it to his estranged daughter before the first snows seal the high passes. Pursued by Corliss's former partners who want the map—and the silver vein it reveals—Ulyana must cross the treacherous Wreckline Range with a ragtag group she slowly comes to call family. At the pass, Ulyana confronts her own blacklisting truth, choosing honesty over self-preservation to save her companions. She delivers the map, refuses the fortune it offers, and finds that loyalty freely given—not silence—was what she'd been searching for all along.
about_author: Dominic Sterling is the pen name of a former alpine rescue volunteer who now writes adventure fiction from a cabin at the edge of the Cascades. Their work explores the moral weight of survival decisions made above the tree line.

chapters.title: The Dying Man's Bargain
chapters.summary: POV Ulyana. Working under a false name at a lowland trading post, Ulyana is found by Corliss, a frostbitten prospector with days to live. He trades his map of an undiscovered silver vein for her promise to reach his daughter, Vera, in the mining town of Hollowmere. Ulyana accepts reluctantly, recognizing the route crosses the very range where her reputation was destroyed. Emotional beat: reluctant obligation kindling into purpose.

chapters.title: Company of Strangers
chapters.summary: POV alternating between Ulyana and Tamsin, a young runaway stowaway discovered in her supply sled. Forced together, they gather an unlikely expedition crew: Oskar, a disgraced cartographer; and Brann, a mule driver with debts of his own. Corliss's former partners arrive asking questions, forcing the group to leave early and travel light. Emotional beat: wary strangers beginning to function as a team.

chapters.title: What the Pass Remembers
chapters.summary: POV Ulyana. High on the Wreckline Range, the pursuers ambush the party, and a storm traps them in the ruins of the expedition that ruined Ulyana years ago. To get everyone out alive, she must finally confess why she was blacklisted: she abandoned a client to save three others. The truth fractures the group's trust even as it saves their lives. Emotional beat: devastating honesty as the price of survival.

chapters.title: Delivered Before Snow
chapters.summary: POV Tamsin. Racing the season's first blizzard, the survivors reach Hollowmere, where Ulyana gives Vera the map and refuses any share of the silver. Confronted by Corliss's partners one last time, the found family stands together against them, and the town sides with Ulyana after hearing her full story. As snow seals the pass behind them, Ulyana realizes she is no longer running. Emotional beat: belonging earned through truth.
